meta.title: Devlog: August 9, 2026 - August 16, 2026
meta.description: continued work on more reliable task alerts, fairer missed-task challenges, and smoother interactions in due or die.

bullets.text: continued improving task alerts so completed or removed tasks do not leave behind stale notifications.
made phrase-based challenges more forgiving of harmless punctuation and spacing differences while keeping meaningful answers distinct.
worked on keeping missed-task challenges bounded and making mascot voice interactions feel more responsive.

summary.text: i spent this week sanding down a few rough edges in the accountability loop. the goal is still simple: reminders and challenges should be annoying for the right reasons, not because the app is being weird.
